ctx.x: They said you played with Johnny Sincere, but he played, you mean in the same band?

Yeah, in the same band. I had a plan with it on the Airline Highway. It was all by the name of Joe, who was in the nightclub. In the 49, I'll never forget. On the 4900 Airline Highway. He used to go down there every Friday and Saturday.
Did you have two guitars? Oh no, I was playing piano. I played piano on that job. And John Sincere guitar. John Sincere guitar. And who else?

items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: And then when I was in Chicago and I met Oliver

ctx.x: Oh yes, Richard M. Jones, yeah I knew him.
And then when I was in Chicago and I met Oliver and I met Frederick Kepard and I met a gang of them. When did you go to Chicago? In 22. Did you stay long? I stayed 60 days, that's all.
Did you work much as a musician or just not too busy?
